subject: general
question: What is the basic difference in the aggregates at market price and factor cost?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Net indirect taxes.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The basic difference in the aggregates at **market price and factor cost **is net indirect taxes.
 
• The taxes that a nation's government levies on the** creation and sale of products **and services are known as indirect taxes.
 
• One such tax is the **GST** (Goods and Services Tax).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Depreciation: **

 
 
• It is the decrease in the value of an asset over time due to **wear and tear, obsolescence,** or other factors.
 
• It is considered in the calculation of **national income **at **factor cost,** but not at market price.
 
 
 
• **Indirect taxes:**
 
 
• These are taxes levied on **goods and services** rather than on income or profits.
 
• Examples include **GST, excise duty, customs duty,** etc.
 
• They are included in the calculation of national income at **market price**, but not at factor cost.
 
 
 
• **Direct taxes:**
 
 
• These are taxes levied on the **income or profits **of individuals or companies.
 
• Examples include** income tax, corporate tax**, etc.
 
• They are not considered in the calculation of **national income **at either market price or factor cost.
